subject: Demo request from HealthSync — Redwood demo scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@healthsync.io>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from HealthSync — Redwood demo scheduling

Hi Sam —

Thanks for signing up and for your interest in Redwood. I saw your self-serve signup and wanted to see if we could schedule a quick demo to walk through how Redwood can help HealthSync with production inference. Before we lock a time, a few quick qualification Qs so I can tailor the session:

- Primary use case: (e.g., chat assistant, summarization, search/semantic ranking)
- Expected volume: concurrent requests or daily tokens per month (ballpark is fine)
- Timeline: pilot date and expected production go-live
- Any compliance requirements (HIPAA, SOC 2) or private deployment needs?

If you prefer, here are a few 30-minute windows I have next week (all PDT):
- Tue 2026-03-16: 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- Wed 2026-03-17: 09:30–10:00, 15:00–15:30

Or share a Calendly/availability link and I’ll book. I’m copying Dylan from Solutions to join for the technical parts.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-product-deck.pdf (1.8MB)
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@healthsync.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from HealthSync — Redwood demo scheduling

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Answers below: 

- Primary use case: patient-facing chat assistant + automated visit summarization to help clinicians.
- Expected volume: hoping to start with ~50k tokens/day in pilot, scaling to ~1M tokens/day in 6 months. Concurrent users 50–200.
- Timeline: pilot kickoff early April, production by late Q2 2026.
- Compliance: must be HIPAA compatible; we'd prefer a private deployment or VPC options for PHI. Also SOC 2 is required on vendor side.

We’re in PDT. The Wed slots look best for us. Can you do Wed 2026-03-17 at 15:00 PDT? Also please include any pre-reads you think would help.

Best,
Sam Turner
Head of Product, HealthSync
sam.turner@healthsync.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@healthsync.io>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-15T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from HealthSync — Redwood demo scheduling

Sam —

Wed 03/17 at 15:00 PDT works — I’ll pencil it in but want to confirm a couple more quick items so Dylan can prep the right demo:

- Do you have a preferred model family (open models vs. our managed Redwood models)? If unsure, we’ll show a couple of practical options for cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Will you want us to demo Dedicated vs. Private deployment (you mentioned HIPAA/VPC)? We can show the Private deployment flow and KMS/HSM integration if you want.
- Any integration points we should be aware of (EHR vendor, streaming audio for visit notes, etc.)?

I attached our product deck; I’ll follow up with a calendar invite shortly. Copying Dev to loop on infra/compliance questions.

Thanks — 
Marissa

Attachment: redwood-product-deck.pdf (1.8MB)
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@healthsync.io>

Date: 2026-03-16T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request from HealthSync — Redwood demo scheduling

Hey Marissa —

Thanks — quick note that we need to move the demo one week out due to a scheduling conflict on our end. Would Wed 2026-03-24 at 11:00 PDT work instead? Same agenda.

Also to answer your other questions: we don’t have a strict model preference yet; open models are preferred if unit cost/latency are comparable. Integration: Epic for EHR and we do have occasional streaming audio for visit transcripts. We do need HIPAA and SOC 2.

If you can do a short pre-demo call with Dev/infra stakeholders from your side, that’d be great — copy me if you want to loop in others.

Sam

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the heads up — Wed 2026-03-24 at 11:00 PDT is good for us. I’ve sent a calendar invite to your email (HealthSync) and included a short agenda:

Agenda (30m):
- 5m intros & goals
- 10m product demo (chat & summarization flows; Private deployment overview)
- 10m infra/compliance Qs (HIPAA, SOC 2, KMS) — Dylan & Dev on the call
- 5m next steps & pilot cadence

Pre-reads: attached product deck; I’ll also share a short infrastructure checklist for HIPAA readiness before the call.

If that looks good, consider the time confirmed. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
